questions.question: In 5S, 'Seiso' means?
questions.explanation: Seiso is cleaning the workplace and checking equipment while cleaning.

questions.question: Gemba means?
questions.explanation: Gemba is where value is created: the shop floor.

questions.question: What should you do with a near-miss?
questions.explanation: Reporting near-misses fixes hazards before someone gets hurt.

questions.question: When the fire alarm rings, go to the?
questions.explanation: Evacuate calmly by marked routes to the assembly point for headcount.

questions.question: Extinguisher method 'PASS' starts with?
questions.explanation: PASS = Pull pin, Aim at base, Squeeze handle, Sweep side to side.

questions.question: Oil or petrol fire is which class?
questions.explanation: Class B fires involve flammable liquids; use foam, CO2 or dry powder.

questions.question: Wood or paper fire is which class?
questions.explanation: Class A fires involve ordinary solids; water and ABC powder work well.

questions.question: Safety pyramid: many near-misses lead to?
questions.explanation: Many near-misses come before each serious accident, so fixing small ones prevents big ones.

questions.question: ISO standard for occupational safety?
questions.explanation: ISO 45001 sets requirements for occupational health and safety management.

questions.question: ISO standard for environment management?
questions.explanation: ISO 14001 covers environmental management systems.

questions.question: EPF is a scheme for?
questions.explanation: The Employees' Provident Fund builds retirement savings from employee and employer shares.

questions.question: Employee's EPF contribution rate?
questions.explanation: Employees contribute 12% of basic wages plus DA to EPF.

questions.question: Employer share diverted to pension (EPS)?
questions.explanation: Of the employer's 12%, 8.33% (on capped wages) goes to EPS and the balance to EPF.

questions.question: UAN is used for?
questions.explanation: The Universal Account Number links all PF accounts of an employee across jobs.

questions.question: ESI mainly gives workers?
questions.explanation: ESI provides medical care and cash benefits for sickness, maternity and injury.

questions.question: ESI covers employees earning up to?
questions.explanation: Employees earning up to ₹21,000 a month (₹25,000 for disabled) are covered.

questions.question: Statutory minimum bonus rate?
questions.explanation: Bonus rules set a minimum of 8.33% and a maximum of 20% of eligible wages.

questions.question: Gratuity uses how many days' pay a year?
questions.explanation: Gratuity = last wages × 15/26 × completed years of service.

questions.question: OJT stands for?
questions.explanation: OJT teaches skills at the actual workstation under a trainer.

questions.question: A skill matrix shows what?
questions.explanation: A skill matrix maps each person's skill levels so teams can plan training and cover.

questions.question: Multi-skilled operators help when?
questions.explanation: Cross-trained operators keep lines running when a colleague is absent.

questions.question: A training Dojo is used for?
questions.explanation: A Dojo is a practice area where new staff learn skills before working on live lines.

questions.question: Kirkpatrick level 3 measures?
questions.explanation: Level 1 Reaction, 2 Learning, 3 Behaviour on the job, 4 business Results.

questions.question: Induction training is for?
questions.explanation: Induction introduces new employees to the company, rules, safety and culture.

questions.question: In SMART goals, 'M' means?
questions.explanation: SMART = Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound.

questions.question: In KPI, 'P' stands for?
questions.explanation: Key Performance Indicators measure progress toward important goals.

questions.question: MBO means management by?
questions.explanation: Management by Objectives aligns individual goals with company targets.

questions.question: 360° feedback comes from?
questions.explanation: 360° feedback gathers views from manager, peers, team members and sometimes customers.

questions.question: Attrition rate measures?
questions.explanation: Attrition is the percentage of employees who leave in a period.

questions.question: Hou-Ren-Sou: Report, Contact and?
questions.explanation: Japanese teams value timely reporting, informing and consulting with seniors.

questions.question: Genchi Genbutsu means?
questions.explanation: Go to the actual place and see the actual thing before deciding.

questions.question: Suggestion schemes mainly generate?
questions.explanation: Employee suggestions are a key source of small improvement ideas.

questions.question: NSK core values: Safety, Quality, Compliance &?
questions.explanation: NSK names safety, quality, compliance and environment as its core values.

questions.question: Standing orders apply from how many workers?
questions.explanation: Under the Industrial Relations Code, standing orders apply to units with 300+ workers.

questions.question: Strike notice under the IR Code?
questions.explanation: Workers must give 14 days' notice before a strike under the IR Code.

questions.question: A grievance committee resolves?
questions.explanation: The Grievance Redressal Committee handles individual worker disputes.

questions.question: Appointment letters under Labour Codes?
questions.explanation: Employers must now issue appointment letters to every worker.

questions.question: The GA department handles?
questions.explanation: General Affairs runs facilities, transport, canteen, security and admin services.

questions.question: Visitors entering the plant must?
questions.explanation: Registering visitors controls access and ensures a safety briefing and PPE.

questions.question: Rainwater harvesting for TN buildings is?
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu made rainwater harvesting compulsory for buildings.

questions.question: Licence needed for the factory canteen?
questions.explanation: Canteens need FSSAI registration or licence and must follow hygiene rules.

questions.question: Oily rags should go to which waste?
questions.explanation: Oil-soaked cloths are hazardous waste and go to authorised handlers.

questions.question: An STP in the plant treats?
questions.explanation: A Sewage Treatment Plant treats domestic waste water for reuse in gardens or flushing.

questions.question: Used oil can only be given to?
questions.explanation: Used oil is hazardous waste and may go only to authorised recyclers.

questions.question: Company bus drivers must have?
questions.explanation: GA verifies licences, vehicle fitness and seatbelts for staff transport safety.

questions.question: A cyclone emergency plan covers?
questions.explanation: Cyclone plans cover safe shutdown, staff transport, power backup and communication.

questions.question: A first aid box should be?
questions.explanation: First aid kits must be stocked, checked and easy for trained first-aiders to reach.

questions.question: A payslip shows?
questions.explanation: Payslips list gross pay, deductions like PF and tax, and net pay.

questions.question: An exit interview happens when?
questions.explanation: Exit interviews capture reasons for leaving to improve retention.

questions.question: Final wages after exit are due within?
questions.explanation: Under the Labour Codes, wages are paid within two working days of exit.
